title: Effective Strassmann Certificates for Local $p$-adic Dynamical Mordell--Lang Interpolants
summary: The $p$-adic method for Dynamical Mordell--Lang often reduces a residue class of an orbit to the zero set of a locally analytic interpolating function. This paper assumes the standard interpolation, Strassmann, Mahler, and Weierstrass tools, and studies the effective local zero-bound problem that remains after interpolation: certifying the Strassmann index of the resulting one-variable analytic function.
